sparql.query:
PREFIX vng: <http://vng.nl/geometry-ext.ttl#>
SELECT ?base64Data WHERE { BIND(vng:gmCylinder(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0) AS ?a) BIND(3.14159265358979 AS ?pi) BIND(vng:gmRotation(vng:gmCylinder(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0), 90 * ?pi / 180.0, 0.0, 0.0) AS ?b) BIND(0 AS ?union) BIND(vng:gmBooleanOperation(?a, ?b, ?union) AS ?base64Data) }

PREFIX vng: <http://vng.nl/geometry-ext.ttl#>
SELECT ?base64Data WHERE { BIND(vng:gmCylinder(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0) AS ?a) BIND(3.14159265358979 AS ?pi) BIND(vng:gmRotation(vng:gmCylinder(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0), 90 * ?pi / 180.0, 0.0, 0.0) AS ?b) BIND(1 AS ?difference) BIND(vng:gmBooleanOperation(?a, ?b, ?difference) AS ?base64Data) }
